title: [DocDB] Tserver crash during a vector index query involving pagination
body:
Jira Link: [DB-17298](https://yugabyte.atlassian.net/browse/DB-17298)
### Description

Repro steps:

```
CREATE EXTENSION vector
CREATE TABLE test(k int,
                  v int, 
                  embedding vector(3),
                  PRIMARY KEY (k ASC)) 
	SPLIT AT VALUES ((10000), (20000));
CREATE INDEX ON test USING hnsw (embedding vector_l2_ops);

INSERT INTO test(k, v, embedding) SELECT i, 1, vector('[1.0, 1.0, 1.' || lpad(i::text, 5, '0') || ']') FROM generate_series (1,10000) AS i;
INSERT INTO test(k, v, embedding) SELECT i, 2, vector('[100.0, 100.0, 100.' || lpad(i::text, 5, '0') || ']') FROM generate_series (10001,20000) AS i;
INSERT INTO test(k, v, embedding) SELECT i, 3, vector('[200.0, 200.0, 200.' || lpad(i::text, 5, '0') || ']') FROM generate_series (20001,30000) AS i;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION echo_int(i INT)
RETURNS INT
LANGUAGE plpgsql
VOLATILE
AS $$
BEGIN
  RETURN i;
END;
$$;

set yb_debug_log_docdb_requests = true;
set yb_fetch_row_limit = 10;

explain (analyze, dist, debug) 
SELECT * FROM test WHERE v <= echo_int(3) ORDER BY embedding <-> '[1.0, 1.0, 1.0]'::vector LIMIT 100;

```
